Loader.js: Animated loading spinner (five bouncing dots) shown while async work completes.
Used as a lightweight loading indicator anywhere the app needs a visual wait state.
ai/chat-api/sendCoachMessageToServer.js: Client-side HTTP client for the AI coach chat API — sends messages, handles retries, and parses server responses.
Called from ChatWithCoachScreen; routes to your Cloud Run backend, not directly to DeepSeek.
ai/services/askServer.js: Generic helper to POST JSON to the Coach Connect server with auth headers attached.
Used by coach, nutrition, and onboarding features when they need a simple authenticated fetch.
ai/services/markAllMessagesRead.js: Marks all unread trainer/client messages as read in Firestore when the user opens the inbox.
Prevents stale unread badges after the user views their conversations.
ai/tools/cleanupToolParams.js: Sanitizes and normalizes parameters on AI coach tool calls before execution (strips junk, fixes types).
Runs in the tool pipeline so bad model output does not crash Firestore writes.
aiChat/chat-thread/ChatWithCoachScreen.j: The main AI Coach chat screen — message thread, composer, photo attach, voice input, and tool confirmations.
Sends messages to the server, saves history to Firestore, and opens modals when the coach wants to log food, water, sessions, etc.
aiChat/chat-thread/CoachWebSourceCards.j: Renders collapsible citation cards under coach replies that used web search.
Each card links to the source URL so users can verify nutrition or fitness claims.
aiChat/components/CoachFormattedReply.js: Renders coach text replies with markdown formatting (bold, lists, links) and strips hidden tool-call JSON.
Sits in the message bubble so users see clean prose instead of raw model output.
aiChat/components/CoachWebSearchReply.js: Special renderer for coach answers that came from web search — preserves headings and structured nutrition info.
Used instead of plain markdown when the reply includes search-sourced facts.
aiChat/components/MiniOrb.jsx: Small animated orb/glow used as the AI Coach avatar in chat bubbles and headers.
Purely visual — gives the coach a recognizable brand presence in the thread.
When a trainer uses AI Coach, this bar lets them pick which client's data goes into the prompt.
Ensures the coach answers about the selected client, not the trainer's own profile.
aiChat/lib/formatCoachMessageText.js: Copy/paste helpers for coach messages — long-press to copy plain text from a reply.
aiChat/lib/coachMarkdownStyles.js: StyleSheet rules for rendering markdown inside coach bubbles (headings, code, links, citations).
Also turns inline [Source Name] tags into tappable citation pills.
aiChat/tool-modals/toolModalHelpers.js: Shared building blocks for all coach tool modals: title row, confirm/cancel buttons, detail rows, colors.
Not a modal itself — imported by LogWaterIntakeSheet, BookTraineeSessionSheet, etc. so they look consistent.
app/AuthGate.js: Root app gate after Firebase auth — shows login/signup, runs onboarding check, then mounts ClientApp or TrainerApp based on role.
This is the first React tree most users hit; it calls /api/me and reads the user profile from Firestore.
nutrition/settings/NutritionOnboardingWi: Multi-step wizard to set calorie/macro targets, diet preferences, and meal structure when nutrition is first enabled.
Collects inputs, runs TDEE/macro calculations, and saves targets to the user profile before they log food.
nutrition/settings/NutritionSettingsScre: Settings screen to edit daily calorie goal, macro split, and nutrition preferences after initial onboarding.
Changes here update what the daily log rings and AI coach context use as targets.
app/authGateLogic.js: Pure routing logic extracted from AuthGate — decides if onboarding is required without flashing the wrong shell.
Unit-tested separately so auth routing rules can change without touching the full AuthGate component.
auth/detectUserRole.js: Helper functions for AuthGate: normalizeAppRole, profileNeedsOnboarding, isLikelyNewFirebaseUser.
Exported for unit tests in authGate.test.js — not UI, just boolean routing decisions.
app/permissions.js: Requests camera, microphone, and photo-library permission via Expo before barcode scan, voice coach, or photo upload.
Exports check/request helpers used by AuthGate, nutrition barcode, and progress photo flows.
auth/normalizeOnboardingRole.js: Normalizes whether the user chose client or trainer during onboarding into values AuthGate expects.
Prevents role string mismatches ('Client' vs 'client') from routing to the wrong app shell.
auth/services/sendPasswordResetEmail.js: Thin wrapper that triggers password-reset email via Firebase or the backend API.
Called from ForgotPasswordFlow screens when the user submits their email.
client/dashboard/PremiumStatsSection.jsx: Dashboard grid of premium stat cards (workouts, nutrition, hydration, sleep) on the client home/dashboard.
Wraps each stat in gradient borders and pulls live values from daily metrics hooks.
client/home/ClientHomeScreen.styles.js: Legacy StyleSheet for client home — deprecated in favor of clientAppStyles.js.
Kept so older imports do not break; new work should use clientAppStyles.js.
React context holding client shell state: which overlay screen is open, back handlers, and tab visibility.
ClientMainScreen and overlay screens read this instead of prop-drilling navigation state.
client/navigation/ClientShellBottomNav.j: Floating bottom navigation bar on client stack screens (Profile, Settings, etc.) when not on the main tab bar.
Lets users jump back to Home or Coach without losing their place in a sub-screen.
client/navigation/ClientStackScreens.jsx: Deprecated re-export of client overlay screen wiring — use clientOverlayScreens.jsx instead.
Retained for backward compatibility with older navigation imports.
client/navigation/clientOverlayScreens.j: Maps overlay route names to screens: Profile, Settings, FAQ, Terms, Nutrition, Marketplace, Weekly Report, etc.
Rendered on top of ClientMainScreen when user opens settings or support from the client shell.
lib/sessions.js: Date/time formatting helpers for trainer session scheduling (pad2, long date, 12-hour time).
Used by session cards and calendar views to display human-readable session times.
navigation/navigationRef.js: Global React Navigation ref so code outside components can navigate (rootNavigate, goBack, reset).
Used by push notifications and deep links that need to open a specific screen.
nutrition/nutritionTheme.js: Color gradients and tokens for nutrition UI (calorie ring, macro bars, action buttons).
Import NUT_* constants so food cards and the daily log share the same visual language.
nutrition/food-search/searchFoodsService: Singleton class that runs all food search: server API, consensus search, Open Food Facts fallback, and local cache.
FoodSearchScreen calls search() here — you should not call food APIs directly from UI components.
nutrition/barcode/normalizeBarcodeForLoo: Fixes barcode digits from the camera (leading zeros, UPC-A vs EAN-13) before server lookup.
Mobile scanners often drop check digits; this prevents false 'product not found' results.
nutrition/barcode/renderScannedBarcode.j: Formats scanned barcode results for display: macro summary, source label, and confidence badge.
Used after a successful barcode lookup to show what the user scanned before they log it.
nutrition/components/premiumFoodCard/Gra: Renders gradient-colored text using MaskedView (React Native has no CSS background-clip).
Used on premium food cards for stylized calorie/macro numbers.
nutrition/components/premiumFoodCard/Log: Single logged-food row in the daily meal list — transparent card over the meal section background.
Shows food name, serving, calories, and tap-to-edit; used inside NutritionContainer meal cards.
nutrition/components/premiumFoodCard/ind: Barrel export file — re-exports FoodCard, LoggedFoodCard, NutritionFactsSection for clean imports.
Import from this index instead of individual files when using the premium food card kit.
shared/assets/onboardingIconRegistry.js: Maps onboarding option keys (e.g. 'full_gym', 'beginner') to bundled PNG icon require() paths.
OnboardingWizardScreen uses getOnboardingIconSource() so icon paths live in one place.
shared/components/home/MarketplaceHeroCa: Hero card on home that promotes finding a trainer — tap opens marketplace search.
Shown to clients who are not yet linked to a trainer.
shared/components/notes-files/FilesNotes: Hero header for the Files & Notes section with gradient background and add button.
Used on both client and trainer dashboards above the file gallery grid.
shared/icons/LucideLike.js: Hand-drawn SVG icon components (Home, Flame, Target, etc.) matching Lucide style without the dependency.
Used in nav bars and stat cards where @expo/vector-icons does not match the design.
shared/notes-files/spreadsheetRows.js: Encodes spreadsheet rows for Firestore — flattens nested arrays because Firestore forbids them.
Used when trainers edit shared spreadsheets in DocumentEditorModal.
shared/ui/ThemeContext.js: React context for light/dark theme — ThemeProvider wraps the app, useTheme() reads colors in screens.
Drives text/background colors across Coach Connect without hardcoding hex values in every file.
shared/ui/homeStatGradients.js: Gradient color arrays for home stat pills (workout, water, sleep, soreness, etc.).
PremiumStatsSection and dashboard cards import these for consistent stat card styling.
shared/ui/lovableColors.js: Legacy color palette from the original Lovable export — some older screens still reference these tokens.
Prefer theme.js / ios18Theme.js for new UI; migrate away when touching old screens.
shared/utils/formatFileSize.js: Formats byte sizes (KB/MB), short dates, and friendly filenames for the files gallery.
Also detects auto-generated upload names so the UI can show cleaner labels.
trainer/home/TrainerHomeUIComponents.jsx: Deprecated trainer home UI pieces — superseded by trainerDashboardUi.jsx.
Kept for baseline compatibility; new trainer home work goes in trainer/dashboard/.
trainer/navigation/TrainerAppShellContex: React context for trainer shell navigation: overlay stack, selected client, and back behavior.
TrainerMainScreen and trainer overlay screens consume this context.
trainer/navigation/TrainerStackScreens.j: Deprecated trainer overlay wiring — use trainerOverlayScreens.jsx instead.
Legacy import path only; do not add new screens here.
trainer/navigation/trainerOverlayScreens: Maps trainer overlay routes to Profile, Settings, FAQ, Legal, Bug Report, and similar stack screens.
Same pattern as clientOverlayScreens but for the trainer app shell.
utils/dataCacheCleanup.js: Old cache-clearing helper — deprecated in favor of clearDataOnLogout.js.
Do not use in new code; call clearDataOnLogout on sign-out instead.
utils/logError.js: Client-side error logger — captures JS errors and optionally forwards them to the server.
Wraps console.error and integrates with autoLogError for crash reporting.
workouts/plan-generator/requestWorkoutPl: Calls the server to generate an AI workout plan from onboarding answers and Claude/DeepSeek.
Also loads saved onboarding artifacts and plan history from AsyncStorage/Firestore.
workouts/plan-generator/workoutOnboardin: Field labels, icons, and display config for the workout plan generator onboarding form.
Drives the profile pill grid on GenerateMyWorkoutPlanScreen.
workouts/plan-viewer/workoutPlanUiCompon: Shared JSX pieces for rendering a generated workout plan (day headers, exercise blocks, rest notes).
Used by WorkoutPlanResult and the PDF export pipeline.
